components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA for adding to cart, confirming actions. Red background, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #E60012; color: #fff; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b5000b; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(230,0,18,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E60012; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-product-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-product-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15,23,42,0.05); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-badge { padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-card-badge--compatible { background: #ecfdf5; color: #065f46; border-color: #d1fae5; } .ds-card-badge--incompatible { background: #fef2f2; color: #991b1b; border-color: #fee2e2; } .ds-card-badge--warning { background: #fffbeb; color: #92400e; border-color: #fef3c7; } .ds-card-image { aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: #f3f4f6; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.5s ease; } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-card-image img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px 20px; flex: 1; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Geist, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #191c1e; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #6b7280; margin: 6px 0 0; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card-footer { padding: 12px 20px; border-top: 1px solid #f3f4f6; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-card-price { font-family: Geist, monospace; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1rem; color: #191c1e; }

components.css: .ds-sidebar { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; width: 280px; position: sticky; top: 96px; } .ds-sidebar-group { margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-sidebar-label { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #6b7280; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-checkbox { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #374151; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 0; } .ds-checkbox input[type="checkbox"] { accent-color: #E60012; width: 16px; height: 16px; }

narrative.overview: A technical, utilitarian interface built for motorcycle owners and mechanics who value accuracy over aesthetics. The system prioritizes functional clarity — compatibility status, OEM references, and part specifications are always visible and unambiguous. The visual language borrows from workshop environments: structured, high-contrast, information-dense, with the Suzuki red serving as a precision accent rather than decorative color.
keyCharacteristics: Compatibility-first information hierarchy: green (compatible), red (incompatible), amber (unvalidated) are the primary visual signals
Technical typography: uppercase labels, monospace OEM numbers, dense data tables
White cards on a cool-grey surface with minimal shadow, relying on border contrast for depth
Workshop-grade density: compact spacing, small font sizes, information packed into every surface

rules.name: The Traffic Light Rule
rules.body: Every product card must show exactly one compatibility status color at the top. Green = compatible, red = incompatible, amber = no motorcycle selected.

rules.name: The Red Accent Rule
rules.body: Suzuki Red (#E60012) appears on ≤15% of any given screen area. Its scarcity preserves its power as a precision signal.

rules.name: The Mono Lock Rule
rules.body: OEM numbers, part specifications, and prices always render in Geist monospace.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, sticky positioning, modal overlay).

dos: Do always show the compatibility status badge at the top of every product card
Do use Geist monospace for all OEM numbers, spec values, and prices
Do use uppercase + letter-spacing for categorical labels
Do maintain the traffic-light status system consistently
Do keep card backgrounds white on the cool-grey surface
Do use rounded-2xl for containers, rounded-xl for interactive elements
donts: Don't use Suzuki Red as a大面积 background — it is a precision accent
Don't add decorative shadows to resting cards
Don't mix technical/monospace text with body text in the same line
Don't use warm or neutral-warm backgrounds
Don't add decorative elements, gradients, or visual flourishes
Don't break the compatibility status color system
